original_value: DataTraveler 50 is a lightweight USB Flash drive that's available in capacities from 8GB to 128GB. The drive's compact, cap less design features a metal casing and colorful accents that range by capacity. Fast2 USB 3.1 Gen 1 (USB 3.0)3 performance ensures quick and easy data transfer. Backward compatible with existing USB 2.0 ports, the drive is also customisable4. DT 50 is backed by a five-year warranty, free technical support and legendary Kingston reliability.
